title: Okugezesebwa kw’Ennyonta
intro: Ekitundu, ekyali kyegomba obukulembeze okulwanirira ensonga yaabwe, kyasaba omuduumizi alondebwe ku bo. Okusaba kwabwe bwe kwaddibwamu, oyo eyalondebwa yasisinkanibwa n’okubuusabuusa, kubanga omuntu ono ssekinnoomu teyalina kitiibwa kya nsi kye baali basuubira. Nga tebannaba kulwanagana okusembayo, omukulembeze ono omupya yandigezesezza empisa zennyini ez’amagye n’okugezesebwa okwangu, naye nga kwa maanyi, okw’okuziyiza.
clues: Nalondebwa okuba omuduumizi oluvannyuma lw’abantu bange okusaba omukulembeze okulwana mu kkubo lya Allah.
Bangi ku bantu bange bennyini baasooka kubuusabuusa okulondebwa kwange, nga bagamba nti sirina bugagga n’olunyiriri lwange olw’ekitiibwa.
Nalondebwa kubanga Allah yali ampadde okumanya okungi n’ekikula ky’omubiri eky’amaanyi.
Akabonero akalabika obulungi ak’okulondebwa kwange okw’obwakatonda kwe kudda kw’Essanduuko y’Endagaano, eyasitulibwa bamalayika, ekyaleeta emirembe mu mitima gy’abakkiriza.
Bwe nnali ntambula n’abaserikale bange, nnalangirira nti twali tugenda kugezesebwa ku mugga.
Nalagira eggye lyange nti oyo yenna anywa ennyo ku mugga si wa kibiina kyange, so ng’ate abo abaakwata sikopu emu yokka mu ngalo baali basigalawo.

trial.label: Kiki Ekisinga Okugezesa?
options: Okuzimba ekiziyiza okulwanyisa Googi ne Magogi

location.label: Kabonero Ki Akakulu Akalaga Obuyinza Bwange?
options: Ekkooti ya mail ekoleddwa mu kyuma ekigonvu

outcome.label: Kiki Ekyava mu Kampeyini Yange?
options: Okuteekawo olulyo oluwangaala mu linnya lyange

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
